blurb: Guests can do tandem skydives from 8,000 or 11,000 ft with certified instructors, including freefall and canopy ride. Experienced licensed jumpers are welcome with facilities and community support. Progressive Freefall training offers ground school and 8 supervised jumps to earn a solo certificate.
extraNote: Free weather rescheduling if wind, cloud, or visibility fall below safe limits · 461 ON-5 West, Dundas, Ontario, on the edge of the Niagara Escarpment, just west of Hamilton · April through October

quotes.text: OMG!!!! My wife and I crossed skydiving off our bucket list thanks to SWOOP and Rick. From the safety explanation to the jump, he made us feel extremely safe. Look no further — this is where you want to skydive.
Incomparable to anything I've ever done. The staff were all highly educated and helpful from start to finish. Made a memory for a lifetime. I will 100% be back.
It was the most exciting thing I have done in my 75 years of life. I was never afraid. Alex and Rick went above and beyond to make me feel safe!
